messages:
marta: Heads up — cust Rhea LoRA merge looks off in quick eval pack. embedding sim drops ~8% vs baseline, hallucination rate up on retrieval prompts. Pasting high-level outputs below. Anyone free to triage? cc @leo @samir :eyes:

leo: On it. Which merged weights did you use? the 'merge-v2' from the stitcher or the raw checkpoint?

marta: Used merge-v2 w/ alpha=0.7 (the default). Run I used: `python scripts/merge_lora.py --base rhea-base --lora cust_rhea_v1 --out merged-rhea-lora --alpha 0.7`. Quickpack attached (quickpack_rhea.json).

ops-bot: CI: eval-quickpack/2487654321 started by marta

samir: I spun up a local run and confirmed. embedding cosine mean: baseline 0.812 -> merged 0.747. top1 retrieval drops 86.2% -> 78.9%. Small but consistent mismatch on date/number extraction examples — answers drift to neighbouring years. I ran: `python run_eval.py --model merged-rhea-lora --eval quickpack_rhea.json`

anya: Could be tokenizer offsets — did you remap special tokens when merging? Also check the dtype/quant path — are we running int4/inference quantized build for the merged artifact?

leo: Good call. I see the stitcher pipeline applied int4 post-merge quantization for the staging artifact. Try running float32 inference to isolate quantization errors. Command: `python serve_local.py --model merged-rhea-lora --dtype float32 --no-quant`

marta: De-quantizing locally now. If float32 fixes, we can try fuse-bias vs no-fuse, and alpha sweep. Will report back in ~30m.

samir: Also try blending alpha=0.5 and alpha=0.85 — sometimes different alpha trades hallucination vs fidelity. Quick loop I use: `for a in 0.5 0.6 0.7 0.8 0.85; do python scripts/merge_lora.py --base rhea-base --lora cust_rhea_v1 --out merged-a$a --alpha $a; python run_eval.py --model merged-a$a --eval quickpack_rhea.json; done`

ci-bot: Eval results uploaded: artifact://evals/2487654321/summary.json

marta: Float32 run looks much better — cosine mean -> 0.805, top1 -> 85.5%. So quant path is amplifying the drift. Next steps suggested: (1) re-merge with alpha=0.65 and run quant calibration; (2) sweep int4 configs (per-layer clamp / percentile based) and compare; (3) add a non-quant fallback release for the customer while we stabilize. Assigning to @leo for merge sweep and @samir for quant calibration experiments.

leo: :thumbsup: I'll run the alpha sweep + no-fuse vs fuse-bias experiments and push a CSV of quickpack results to /artifacts/rhea/2487654321 by EOD.

samir: :ok_hand: I'll try per-layer clipping and two calibration strategies (KL and MSE) and run targeted 2-shot checks on the failure cases. If quant can't reach parity, we should surface a simple toggle to pin the model to float variant for Rhea Dedicated rollout.

marta: Thanks all — logging action items in the ticket. If anyone finds a quick regression fix (e.g. remap special-tokens or alpha tweak) drop into the same artifact folder.
